name: CPU Backend
description: CPUBackend, the CPU RenderBackend and pixel reference (Sources/CoreRender/CPU): its surfaces are PixelBuffers held in the shared SurfaceStore, and surface, read, release, display and in-place composite (every blend mode, gated by its family) are the CoreRaster calls themselves, with CoreRaster errors mapped to RenderError.raster. Transform, resample, blur, adjust and retouch throw unsupported until render-backend RB-4.
